Check local paw setup

Usage:
  paw doctor [command]

Available Commands:
  models      Check configured model transports

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for doctor

Global Flags:
      --config string       config file
      --no-color            disable colored stderr output
      --trace-file string   trace file
      --verbose             verbose output

Use "paw doctor [command] --help" for more information about a command.
